summary:
# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (for later lookup)

## BOOK 1 of 2: *The Man from Bar 20* (Clarence E. Mulford, Gutenberg 56154)

**Frame:** Cover: "The Man From Bar 20, A Story of the Cow Country", A. L. Burt Co., 1918. Dedicated "to E. V. A." Front matter lists 23 chapters.

**Ch I – A Stranger Comes to Hastings.** Rider (Johnny Nelson, called "Dearly Beloved," from Bar-20, Texas; horse Pepper, black) sings "The Cowboy's Lament," horse objects at verse 29. Shot at from ambush near Twin Buttes; he waits, the ambusher doesn't come to check. Whistle from thicket. Reaches Hastings. Pop Hayes (saloon owner, dozes, feet on table, sleeps most of day). Showcase has item "Lean on yourself." Stranger buys box of .45s. Pop: "dead image" of Logan. Pop recommends Circle S (Holmes; no need), Long T (Smith, miserly), CL (Logan, east, Deepwater Valley: "gives men two hours sleep"). Parrot Andrew Jackson ("Andy"), green, swears, drinks whiskey; bites stranger's finger attempt fails. Johnny leaves; Pop: "Don't you tell Logan that I sent you!" Pop thinks Johnny wears guns for gunman/Twin Buttes gang.

**Ch II – A Question of Identity.** Johnny arrives CL corral; Logan (foreman John C. Logan) offers $40 low / $70 "as a starter" + $10 per six-gun. Johnny's bio: 5'10", 160 lbs, blue eyes, brown hair, "Dearly Beloved"; from Bar-20 (Texas), Tin Cup (Montana) later. Recounts friends: Hopalong Cassidy (married Mary; son William, Junior, age 5), Red Connors (Red, pants), Skinny, Lanky, Pete Wilson (Pete), Buck (Buck Peters, married Rose), Tex Ewalt, Youbet Somes (dead, killed fighting seven sheepherders), Cookie. Johnny mentions Tin Cup, Twin River sisters. Logan doubts identity; Johnny produces a letter-exhibit: letter from William Cassidy Senior (Tin Cup) confirming; red undershirt, scab on ear, shotgun promise. Logan accepts: "Will you stay for th' dance?" Johnny: "Sweet bells of joy!"

**Ch III – The Wisdom of the Frogs.** Johnny rides range two weeks. Found burned homestead (nesters). Describes Barrier (limestone ledge), Twin Buttes, Deepwater River, ford between CL and Hastings. Letter from Cassidy Sr. (Wm. Cassidy, Senior) to Logan: Johnny's undershirt, Pete, William Jr. shot at calf, "God have mercy on your soul." Logan & Johnny night talk about rustlers; Johnny will prospect near Twin Buttes; green bush at foot of Barrier north of Little Canyon as signal. Frogs chant "Go 'round! Knee deep!" Logan: "'Go round' is th' medicine."

**Ch IV – A Feint.** Johnny tells Pop he quit CL (Logan's cow-night-air notion: drive cows from river). Says he'll prospect. Pop warns "Keep away from Twin Buttes." Quigley (Tom Quigley) enters, Johnny's gun pointed at Quigley's pin; Quigley says Twin Buttes is dangerous, mentions two earlier prospectors. Johnny buys outfit from Charley James (general store, solitaire): axe (Little Gem three-pounder), gold pan, fishhooks, line, reel, pole. Johnny returns after one week with gold "pocket" and trout; spins story "found them in a draw east of Devil's Gap."

**Ch V – Preparations.** Johnny's cabin in valley north of Little Canyon (Nelson's creek); cached gold. Describes guns: wooden-handled flare-butt Frontiers, no ivory; Hopalong taught him; he shoots from hips; Red taught him rifle (Sharps). Logan gives rope (60 ft) and iron bar.

**Ch VI – A Moonlight Reconnaissance.** Johnny climbs rim above rustler pasture (QE / Quigley's sink). Sees stone houses (three), canyon, spring diverted under house corners. Wolf scares him. Returns; rope missing; horse Pepper saddled; Johnny concludes rustlers watched.

**Ch VII – A Council of War.** Johnny leaves note-lined cabin, sets thread trap. Rebrands six cows CL→GB. Ackerman (Jim Ackerman, a gunman, grimy, snarls) and Fleming (Art?/Jim names used) watch; Ackerman leaves note "Vamose" on Johnny's door. Quigley and Ackerman council: Quigley wants frame-up to get Johnny killed/discredited; Ackerman plans pot-shooting. Quigley says Ackerman is "little boy's class." Quigley = "smart" leader, rustlers' leader.

**Ch VIII – Fleming Is Shown.** Johnny at Hastings, sign "Back at 4 P.M." Pop & Charley fish-fight argument (eight-pound brook trout). Ackerman challenges Johnny at Pop's window; Ackerman's fast draw; Johnny jabs Colt in his stomach, slaps, boots him, makes him crawl; Ackerman's gun empties; Johnny takes his ivory-handled gun; Fleming's gun taken; Johnny: "I'm leavin' th' valley... Quigley don't own this country."

**Ch IX – A Skirmish in the Night.** Johnny returns to cabin, smoke, burned cabin; ambush by Harrison (Nat Harrison), Gates (Ben Gates, 'Benjamin Franklin Gates'), Fleming. Gates tied up in woods; Johnny's cougar shot; Johnny gets the cougar onto Harrison's arms. Fleming wounded (thigh/shoulder); Harrison wounded in arm; Gates creased on head; Johnny takes guns; leaves pants torn; Johnny: "Adios."

**Ch X – A Change of Base.** Johnny moves to Twin Buttes south butte cave-camp; scouts Quigley's valley (13 miles long, 8 wide, Rustler Creek, lakes, swamp, three exits). Quigley's brand QE (from CL). Calf-count proof.

**Ch XI – Nocturnal Activities.** Night raid: Quigley, Ackerman, Purdy, Holbrook, Fleming, Gates, Harrison; cook (Cookie) with poisoned coyote/chickens; cattle swam Deepwater to CL range. Johnny sneaks near cook's shack, follows through creek.

**Ch XII – Yeasty Suspicion.** Rustlers brand; Ackerman goes off alone to find Johnny; Quigley warns; Ackerman "Ain't there no way to get it through yore heads?"

**Ch XIII – An Observant Observer.** Pop/Charley cribbage argument; Ackerman learns from Pop Johnny went south; meets Long Pete (Pete Carson, Circle S fired); Pete joins Ackerman as cook/companion; Pete suspects Johnny's spot.

**Ch XIV – The End of a Trail.** Gates & Harrison see trail; Pete sent on creek; Harrison shoots Pete mistaking him for Johnny (Pete killed at mesa). Ackerman faces Johnny at hidden canyon; Ackerman's horse freed; Ackerman shot dead by Johnny (Ackerman's rifle/pistol draw). Johnny camps south Twin Buttes near Pepper.

**Ch XV – Blindman's Buff.** Johnny ambushes at the blind canyon trail; Harrison dies falling; Gates wounded (face, leg), taken home to ranch on horse.

**Ch XVI – The Science of Sombreros.** Johnny atop southern Twin; Fleming fires; sombrero ruse; Sanford (Sanford, Spencer carbine); Johnny kills Sanford? (Sanford with neck-wound). Copperhead bites; Johnny kills snake.

**Ch XVII – Treed.** Johnny up butte; rustlers fire; Fleming killed by a knife at camp (Luke later). Johnny climbs down, rejoins Pepper. Skunk smell disables Fleming.

**Ch XVIII – At Bay.** Johnny holds top of south butte; rustlers light fire below; he rolls rocks; Holbrook climbs, wounded.

**Ch XIX – An Unwelcome Visitor.** Grizzly visits Johnny; Johnny with Sharp's kills it. Quigley offers Johnny deal; Johnny rejects; Quigley shot in arm.

**Ch XX – A Past Master Draws Cards.** Luke Tedrue (old scout; Remington .44; Colonel Bowie knife) leaves CL to help Johnny, reaches Twin Buttes; meets Johnny at night: "two ijuts."

**Ch XXI – Scouting as a Fine Art.** Quigley tracks Johnny; finds Fleming's dead body (knifed); Purdy with Pepper.

**Ch XXII – "Two Ijuts."** Luke and Johnny plan raid on stone houses; diverted water ditch; cut bank.

**Ch XXIII – "All but th' Cows."** Night attack. Gates falls in water-cistern trapdoor (killed by Luke/Johnny); Purdy wounded; Johnny fights Quigley in creek; Quigley shot. Johnny: "All but th' cows." Logan arrives: "Are they all gone under?" Johnny: "All but th' cows."

*(Book 1 ends with publisher's catalogue of A. L. Burt titles.)*

---

## BOOK 2 of 2: *The Coming of Cassidy—And the Others* (Clarence E. Mulford, Gutenberg 42441; 1913, A. C. McClurg)

**Preface:** Narrator says Red (under-foreman) told him Bar-20 history. Buck Peters bought "ranch" on Snake Creek in the '70s; syndicate; 2,000 cattle; Red went back with drive; George Travis (Buck's first hand; later killed). Bill Cassidy appears.

**Contents:** I The Coming of Cassidy; II The Weasel; III Jimmy Price; IV Jimmy Visits Sharpsville; V The Luck of Fools; VI Hopalong's Hop; VII "Dealing the Odd"; VIII The Norther; IX The Drive; X The Hold-Up; XI Sammy Finds a Friend; XII Sammy Knows the Game; XIII His Code; XIV Sammy Hunts a Job; XV When Johnny Sloped.

**I – The Coming of Cassidy.** Bill Cassidy (age ~20, "Cimarron" trail boss's puncher) rides north; meets two buffalo hunters at Buck's sod dugout on Snake Creek; hunters' plot. Buck Peters (foreman) and puncher George Travis. Bill sees gray wolves in line; suspicion. Hunters ambush Travis (knifed in back, dead) and attack Buck; Bill fights hunter (Berserker), takes his gun; hunter (other) killed/caught: Bill takes hunter prisoner (tied with 40-foot lariat). Buck wounded in shoulder by Bill's gun-shot? Buck's pardner: Bill and Buck shake hands. Bill's horse: White-Eye / Ring-Bone / Hammer-Head (mentioned).

**II – The Weasel.** Skinny Thompson (6'4") and Lanky Smith (5'-ish, friends) split; Lewis (Frank Lewis) tells Skinny Lanky went north to Buck. Skinny at Scoria, Quiggs' saloon; Dick Bradley and Sam Bradley feud over card cheating; Skinny kills Dick in street; Sam shot in the night at camp. Lanky with buffalo-man Jim, George, Charley, leader (wizened, Butch Lynch "the Weasel"). Lanky shot by Butch Lynch's man; horse shot. Tom Jayne (the Weasel) arrives at Bar-20 as hired hand under Lewis's introduction. Weasel's rustling of Bar-20 cattle at Split Hill Canyon; Red sees Weasel kill rattler. Skinny & Red trail; Weasel vs Bill duel: Bill kills Weasel at gateway; George falls off cliff; Skinny shoots Bradley-ish rustler. Bill & Skinny & Red round up herd.

**III – Jimmy Price.** Jimmy (youth) hired by "Boss" (Tortilla range), Brazo Charley & Longhorn gun-men; Jimmy's guns taken; Jimmy tied; Bill (Cassidy) frees him (Jimmy loads 'law'), Longhorn comes back and is killed by Bill's two guns; Jimmy's exclamation "what'd'ju pay for them chaps?"

**IV – Jimmy Visits Sharpsville.** Bill & Jimmy in Sharpsville (Carter's Emporium; Dad Johnson, Lefty Dawson, George Bruce, Hank, Charley Logan, Carter). Jimmy's fake Apache trophies (G-string, medicine-bag). Pranks: Hank on roof; Carter's water buckets; false Apache scare; Lefty.

**V – The Luck of Fools.** Jimmy & Bill: Asylum (yellow dog). Tom & George French and Mollie (sister) in wagon, drunk guide Whiskey Jeff (Jeff Purdy). Apaches attack; Bill and Jimmy rescue; Purdy holds ledge with lookin'-glass. Logan punchers (Dickinson) arrive.

**VI – Hopalong's Hop.** Bill at Clay Gulch; Victoria & Hawley's hotels; Oleson (Crazy M foreman) offers Bill job to hunt rustlers; Shorty Allen; Bill gunned down by Thomas brothers and Harris (marshal, Toby Harris) in shootout; leg broken; named "Hopalong Cassidy" by Harris. Bill's nickname born: Hopalong.

**VII – "Dealing the Odd."** Hopalong at Colby faro bank; crooked dealer (scar over brow) and case-keeper; Hopalong's winnings; Hopalong tricks shell-game operator (Thomas); gets $ back; "Hopalong" (red-haired, limp).

**VIII – The Norther.** Red tells of the Norther; Johnny (Idaho); Buck Peters; Jimmy spotted campers; Hoppy scouts; Lanky frozen; Skinny finds Lanky; Pete Wilson (migrating, wife left; joins Bar-20 after helping Johnny's blanket). Buck's tribe.

**IX – The Drive.** Herd to Sandy Creek (Diamond Bar, Sam Crawford, Billy Williams); Hopalong's drive route to avoid West Bend flood; Crawford's gun; Hopalong beats Crawford (stampede event); Cookie chuck-wagon; Jimmy lost in stampede.

**X – The Hold-Up.** Train hold-up (conductor Simms, brakeman, express messenger Jackson); dynamite; Red's wounded forehead; Hopalong & Red; Skinny; fat passenger with six-dollar gun; woman's kiss; Hopalong's mare.

**XI – Sammy Finds a Friend.** Sammy Porter (cub, gold teeth conflicts), Ace Fisher? no—Sammy in Logan's faro in Kansas City; woman Annie (gold teeth, piano player), gambler Jim; Sammy loses; Hopalong rescues Sammy's money from cheat.

**XII – Sammy Knows the Game.** Hopalong & Sammy at Sandy Creek; Annie Allison; Joe Worth foreman; fight; Sammy's ruse with handkerchief; Sammy beats bartender.

**XIII – His Code.** Youbet Somes (ex-foreman, Two-X-Two, hates wire/sheep) at Kit; sheepman sheep-herders (Clayton, Towne, Schultz, Baxter, Price, Oleson) at Logan's; Youbet killed seven? Youbet shot dead defending Waffles; Price wounded.

**XIV – Sammy Hunts a Job.** Sammy at Truxton; Blinky Thompkins cook; Olmstead restaurant; Tom Clarke; drummer; Sammy's threats; Clarke's wrist injury; Johnny jealous.

**XV – When Johnny Sloped.** Johnny Nelson; diamond tie; Cookie; Norah Joyce; sheriff Nolan threatens; Johnny kills Nolan? (Johnny shoots Nolan in Palace); George Greener (rival, widower) marries Norah; Johnny gives diamond pin to bride; Johnny returns; outfit pays for "it all."

*(Book 2 ends with "THE END".)*
